passages.title: BC Greens announce plan to lift the freeze on 10-a-day daycare, universal free child care by 2031
passages.quote: Make registering for care simple: create one point of registration for $10/day spaces across B.C., replacing today’s centre-by-centre waitlists so families no longer have to win a lottery to access affordable care. Make it easier for early childhood centres to become, and remain, part of the $10/day spaces by reducing burdensome compliance paperwork. New spaces and priority registration going to public, non-profit and Indigenous-led centres, building a system rooted in community care, not private profit. Create a universal early childhood education funding model to reduce administrative burdens for childcare operators, allowing them to focus on quality care for children.
